text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria's voters go to polls on Thursday to express their desire for national unity and stability.
- New political scenery will emerge from Thursday's referendum on a draft constitution.
- An official panel is preparing a new party law with a proposal requiring party founders to have at least 800 supporters in 20 regions.
- European Commission's deputy head, Manuel Marin, arrives on Sunday in Algiers to discuss an association accord between Algeria and the European Union.
- The authorities to review shipping law to allow private operations to compete with state-owned companies.
- President Liamine Zeroual installs a high education council and urges reforms of the education system.
